prompts.title: Geometric Poise
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image ONLY for face and identity reference.
Do not beautify, stylize, or modify identity. Keep real skin texture, pores, and imperfections.

Create a 4:5 aspect-ratio, hyper-realistic, cinematic studio portrait of a stylish man seated on minimalist geometric blocks in a dark studio environment. The subject has an athletic, well-defined physique and a calm, confident expression, looking directly at the camera.
Pose & Composition:

The subject is seated on a central light-gray cubic block. Legs are naturally spread in a relaxed yet confident stance — one leg slightly extended forward while the other remains bent. One hand rests firmly on his thigh, while the other hand hangs relaxed between the legs, adding a grounded, masculine presence. Posture is natural, upright, but not stuffy. Framing is mid-to-full body (knees to head), vertically centered.
Outfit (IMPORTANT):

Formal, clean and premium —

A tailored medium-gray suit (not dark charcoal, not light silver — balanced neutral gray tone), paired with a crisp plain white shirt inside.

Slim-fit matching trousers with clean tailoring.

Minimal white low-top sneakers, smooth finish, no heavy branding.
Hair & Grooming:

Natural, modern hairstyle with a clean fade on the sides and slightly voluminous, neatly styled top.
Environment:

Pure black studio background with no texture or distractions. Very subtle floor visibility.

Multiple bright light-gray cubic blocks are arranged asymmetrically around the subject at varying heights to create depth and a modern geometric composition.
Lighting (CRITICAL):

Professional cinematic lighting setup —

Soft frontal key light for natural skin tone and facial clarity.

Strong red rim lighting from the left side and slightly behind, creating glowing red highlights along the hair, jawline, shoulders, arms, and suit edges.

Subtle red reflections visible on the suit and surrounding blocks.

High contrast with controlled shadows, maintaining depth and drama.
Style & Quality:

High-end fashion editorial photography, ultra-realistic, 8K resolution, sharp focus, detailed skin texture, realistic fabric folds, clean composition, cinematic depth, premium studio aesthetic.

prompts.title: Urban Street Stylish Young Boy
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-end cinematic lifestyle portrait of a stylish man with well-groomed hair, exuding a confident, cool, and composed personality. Use the uploaded image strictly as the ONLY face & identity reference. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, and natural texture.
Outfit:

A relaxed-fit maroon button-down shirt featuring bold white rose floral patterns, sleeves rolled up to mid-forearm, Shirt must be worn untucked (naturally draping over the waistband, not tucked in). Paired with light sky-grey relaxed tapered trousers (clean fall, tailored finish) and crisp white high-top leather sneakers with matching laces.
Pose & Expression:

The subject leans casually against a blue-framed glass window. His right arm raised with hand resting on the frame. Left leg crossed over the right in a relaxed stance. His left hand lightly touching the chin. Expression is focused and slightly intense, with a confident, smoldering gaze directed straight into the camera.
Composition & Framing:

Full-body vertical portrait (head-to-toe, feet fully visible, no cropping). Subject positioned slightly left of center following the rule of thirds. Maintain balanced negative space on both sides. Use the window frame and sidewalk lines as leading elements to create depth and perspective.
Environment & Background:

Urban street setting at dusk. Left side features a modern architectural building with a blue-grid glass facade. Background shows a softly blurred city street with yellow-black striped traffic barriers. Multiple streetlights recede into the distance forming a strong leading perspective, glowing as soft circular bokeh. The sky displays a rich cinematic sunset gradient — deep orange near the horizon transitioning into pink and subtle purple tones. Car headlights and distant city lights enhance the depth. No people visible in the background.
Lighting:

Golden hour cinematic lighting with a vivid sunset sky acting as a natural backlight. A warm directional streetlight casts a soft golden glow across the subject’s face and upper body, creating natural highlights and depth. Strong subtle rim light from the horizon outlines the silhouette. Streetlights in the background contribute additional ambient glow and bokeh. Face illumination must feel realistic and balanced — soft falloff, no harsh shadows, no overexposure.
Camera Angle & Lens:

Low-to-mid eye-level angle with a slight upward perspective to enhance presence and stature. Shot using an 85mm lens for a compressed, cinematic look.
Technical Details:

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution. Shallow depth of field (f/1.8–f/2.8) creating creamy background bokeh, especially from streetlights and headlights. High texture fidelity on fabric, skin, and surfaces. Teal-and-orange cinematic color grading with realistic dynamic range.
Aspect Ratio:

2:3 vertical composition.
